capabilities: Insert a handwriting block at the cursor position
Draw with pen, highlighter, eraser, and text tools
Save drawings as SVG files in a configurable vault folder
Embed references to existing handwriting SVG files
Configure colours, pen size, background, and paper pattern
disambiguation: Drawings stay as editable SVG strokes; there is no handwriting-to-text (OCR) conversion.
extras: README states all data stays local with no network requests, analytics, or telemetry; on Android it writes a .nomedia file so drawings are excluded from the gallery; S Pen side-button erasing is supported where the device exposes it to Obsidian.
intentEvidence: It began from the MIT-licensed HandTranscriptMd project
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to handwrite or sketch directly within a note.

relations.evidence: It began from the MIT-licensed HandTranscriptMd project

summary: Pen-first drawing canvas that inserts and edits handwriting blocks inside Markdown notes, storing each drawing as an SVG file in the vault.
